name: support-routing
description: Small labeled set of inbound support messages.
methodology: Examples are synthetic, authored by hand to cover each department, both urgency outcomes, and several deliberately ambiguous or boundary cases (security concerns, churn threats, entitlement-vs-billing overlap). Labels reflect the author's judgement and were not reviewed by a support team; ambiguous cases are marked in the example notes. There is no production support traffic for this project to sample from instead. This set is still small and hand-authored, not sampled from real traffic, and does not support a general accuracy claim.
